First release of MP-ASH-Viewer, a fork of [ASH Viewer](https://github.com/akardapolov/ASH-Viewer): Active Session History for Oracle, including Standard Edition and without the Diagnostics Pack (OracleSE profile).

**Download** `MP-ASH-Viewer-v1.0.1.zip`, unzip it and follow `README.txt` (Java 11+ with graphics, the Oracle JDBC driver in `lib/`, then `exec_ashv.sh` or `exec_ashv.bat`).

Main features: Top Activity with filters and Group by, local History, Compare two periods (plan changes, more executions or slower ones), lock tree, Now: Sessions / Now: Resources, SQL texts kept in the history, Admin (disk, purge, export / import of a period), English and Portuguese, light / dark / classic themes, About window.

Details: [README](https://github.com/mpontes-stack/MP-ASH-Viewer#readme) and [FEATURES](https://github.com/mpontes-stack/MP-ASH-Viewer/blob/melhorias-ui/docs/FEATURES.md).
